issues.title: These need fixing before the budget can be saved:
summary.nothing_else: nothing else is taken from savings
summary.pots_callout: Pots that could cover it are on Overview.
month.heading: Where {month}'s money goes
insights.heading: What the numbers say
insights.empty: Add income and costs to see insights.
now.heading: This month: {month}
now.empty: Nothing logged this month yet. Tell your AI assistant what you spent, or use “bbbudget log”.
activity.heading: Recent changes
activity.text: Every change, whoever made it: you, an AI assistant or a rate refresh. Undo puts back the version from before it, as a new change you can undo too.
short.title: {month} is {amount} short
short.untouched: Nothing is taken from your savings automatically.

short.more.one: One more month falls short later.

short.no_pots: None of your pots holds money then.
short.owed_note: If you leave it, it's owed on your current account and repaid from the next month with money to spare. That usually costs interest or fees.
cover.name: Cover {month}
items.heading: Income and costs
items.text: Change an amount right in the list, or open an item for the rest. ≈ is the monthly amount in {currency}.
items.empty: No items yet. Add your income and regular costs.
sheet.base_income: Each payment you receive ≈ {amount} in {base}, after cash-out loss.
sheet.base_cost: Each payment ≈ {amount} in {base}, transfer loss included.
route.income_help: Pick a pot to save all of it straight away, for example a sale or a bonus. It then isn't spendable that month and no share of it goes to debts.
route.cost_help: Pick a pot to pay this from savings you set aside for it. If the pot holds less, the rest comes out of that month.
field.name: Name
field.label: Label
debts.heading: Debts
debts.empty: No debts. Add credit cards or loans to see interest and payoff dates.
debt.not_paid: not paid off in this window
debt.help_interest: Interest is charged monthly at APR ÷ 12. The minimum is paid each month until the balance is zero.
debt.help_payoff: Pays the whole balance in that month, interest included, in place of the minimum. Income sent to the same pot that month, such as a sale, arrives first. If the pot holds less, it pays what it can and the rest stays owed.
flow.heading: Where leftover money goes
flow.text: Each month, what's left after spending and minimum debt payments goes through these steps, in order. Income you send straight to a pot (on its item) skips them.
flow.repay.owes: A short month is owed on your current account; the next leftover pays it back first.
flow.repay.none: Nothing is owed in this plan.
flow.fixed.none: None. Set “Put in each month” on a pot.
flow.extra.some: A share of what's left pays debts down faster.
flow.extra.none: No debts with a balance, so this step is skipped.
flow.share_aria: Share of leftover to debts, percent
flow.targets: Fill pots that have a target, top to bottom
flow.targets.list: {list}. Change the order in a pot's editor.
flow.targets.none: None. Set a target on a pot.
flow.rest.detail: The first general pot gets whatever is left.
pots.heading: Savings pots
pots.text: Savings are never spent to cover a short month unless you plan it. To send a sale or bonus straight into a pot, or pay a cost from one, open that item and pick the pot.
pots.empty: No pots. Add one: money left over each month goes there.
pot.default: gets the rest of the leftover
pot.help.order: Order matters: targets fill top to bottom, and the first general pot gets the rest.
pot.help.general: General savings is offered first when a month falls short.
pot.help.sinking: Money saved ahead for a known cost. If a short month uses it, that cost is delayed.
pot.help.emergency: For emergencies. Offered only as a last resort when a month falls short.
pot.help.target: A pot with a target stops filling once it's reached.
pot.in_use.item: {name} is used by the item {other}. Route that item elsewhere first.
pot.in_use.debt: {name} pays off the debt {other}. Change that first.
pot.keep_one: Keep at least one pot: money left over each month goes there.
wd.heading: Transfers from savings
wd.text: Money you move out of a pot into a month, for example to cover a short month. It shows as “from savings”, never as income.
wd.empty: None. Nothing leaves your pots unless you plan it here.
wd.help: Never takes more than the pot holds at the time; the plan warns if it falls short.
scenarios.heading: Try a change
scenarios.text: See what a change would do without touching the real budget. Save it as a scenario to compare side by side.
scenarios.bad_value: Each new value must be a plain number like 800 or 92.5

scenarios.result.one: After {count} month: {after} instead of {before}. This month saves {saved}.
scenarios.result.other: After {count} months: {after} instead of {before}. This month saves {saved}.

scenarios.name: Scenario name
scenarios.empty: Add a change, for example rent down to 1,000 or a different exchange rate, then preview it.
compare.heading: Saved scenarios
settings.heading: Budget settings
currencies.heading: Currencies
currencies.text: Each rate comes from the ECB's official rate, market data (which also covers crypto), or is typed by hand.
cur.help: Payment loss is added to every payment in this currency. Cash-out loss is taken off income in it, such as fees for selling crypto. Typing a rate makes it manual.
rate.fetch_failed: Couldn't get the {code} rate ({error}), so nothing changed. To use {code} anyway, set “Rate from” to “Typed by hand” and type its rate.
rates.off: Fetching rates is turned off in Settings.
rates.all_manual: Every rate is typed by hand. Pick a “Rate from” source for the ones to keep current.
categories.heading: Categories
categories.in_use: “{label}” is still used by an item.
new.title: New budget
new.id: Id (used in URLs and by Claude)
delete.confirm: Delete {name} permanently? This can't be undone.
prefs.title: Settings
prefs.language.heading: Language
prefs.language.text: For this page, the insights and the command line. Assistants answer in the language you write in.
prefs.language.label: Language
prefs.rates.heading: Exchange rates
prefs.rates.text: These apply to every budget. Each budget's own settings (base currency, months, debt strategy) are on the budget page.
prefs.fetch: Fetch exchange rates from the internet
prefs.fetch_hint: Off means fully offline: nothing contacts a rate provider, and every rate is typed by hand.
prefs.auto_status: Automatic updates run while “bbbudget serve” is running.
prefs.cg.heading: CoinGecko API key
prefs.cg.text: Optional. CoinGecko works without a key but limits how often it answers. A free demo key from coingecko.com raises the limit. The key is stored in your settings file and never shown again.
prefs.cg.placeholder: Paste a key to set or replace it
prefs.files.heading: Where things are stored
